goal: Bound SourceIdentity Git inspection by canonical path and time, fail closed on timeout, and rerun the blocked external-executor real project.
acceptance_criteria: Every SourceIdentity Git subprocess has a maximum of 20 seconds and the capture has a 45-second total budget.
Status, diff, and untracked inspection use one canonical-source pathspec and never use --untracked-files=all.
Relevant tracked, untracked, and root VERSION changes alter identity while excluded runtime trees do not.
Timeout is a structured GIT_COMMAND_TIMEOUT and production stops BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT before Provider or discovery.
Canonical repository publication retains full-worktree classification and its receipt binding.
No new production module, Agent, scheduler, executor type, lifecycle stage, or authority is introduced.

quality_metrics.target: less than 10 seconds; hard budget 45 seconds
quality_metrics.method: capture timing metadata and live production evidence

quality_metrics.measure: excluded runtime paths affecting source identity
quality_metrics.method: local fixture and large excluded-tree regression

quality_metrics.measure: new agents, schedulers, executor types, formal stages, or authorities
quality_metrics.method: kernel contract and architecture regression tests

prevention: Apply one canonical pathspec and explicit timeout to every read-only Git inspection
assurance: Cover timeout, Git failure, tracked/untracked/root changes, excluded trees, determinism, and publish compatibility
control: Run tests in the prescribed order, then official live real-project acceptance and bounded quick
improvement: Keep publication safety separate from the narrower source identity responsibility

interface_expectations: CGKNSourceIdentityReport keeps schema 1.0 and all existing core fields
working_tree_clean means canonical/relevant source cleanliness only
Provider, discovery, formal evidence, packaging, delivery, and publication authorities remain unchanged

feedback: Bounded canonical-source inspection reached Provider in 0.444093 seconds on the official live route.
The external-executor acceptance remains NEEDS_REWORK because all five upstream Provider attempts timed out before response headers.

worked: One pathspec, native Git resolution, noninteractive environment, and per-command plus total budgets removed the startup hang.
did_not_work: Git-for-Windows wrapper termination initially left a child process holding captured pipes.
experiments: Keep source identity scoped to canonical source while canonical publication independently classifies the full worktree.
